clause: Barrier (CauseBarrier steps; 'Barrier all Allies' / 'Gain a Barrier' / 'Barrier an Ally')

actual: Assembler emits {kind:'status',statusId:'barrier',turns:3}; tickStatuses decrements every non-poison status at the owner's turn start, so an unused Barrier disappears after 3 owner turn-starts (real TurnEngine.passTurn flow).

clause: 'and Silence them' / native step 2 CauseSilence (applies to every negative status with turns:3)
expected: Official guide describes negative statuses as wearing off through a cumulative cleanse chance per turn (Curse text: 10% -> 5% cumulative; Terror: 'chance to cleanse at the start of each turn similar to other negative status effects'); no fixed duration is stated.
actual: Silence gets 10% cumulative recovery AND a hard 3-turn cap. Because the victim's turn start ticks right after the cast, the enemy is silenced for at most 2 of its own turns (turns 3 -> 2 at its first turn start).

note: Hard cap is not an explicit official rule and not an explicit user ruling (GEMS-SEMANTICS-2 lists the 3-turn value as an open question). Needs fix-window ruling.
update0340: Official guide (saved official-status-effects.html) describes negative statuses as removed only by a cumulative per-turn cleanse chance (10%, 5% when Cursed); Lycanthropy entry gives the example 30% after 3 turns then 40%, which is incompatible with a 3-turn hard cap. Death Mark = 10%/turn death roll (engine already does this). Trial fix (sa-L5, 03:20, reverted): tickStatuses skips turns decrement for AUTO_RECOVER statuses except submerged. Blast radius: 7 non-lane unit tests assert the old countdown (statusEffect.test.ts x2 incl. requirement 9.5 expiry, webStatus.test.ts x2, passTurn.test.ts x1, castTurnLifecycle.test.ts x2) + 10 own L5B01 cases; no frozen evidence of other lanes broke. Not applied because it changes a spec requirement (9.5) and every negative status across lanes; needs coordinator ruling, then it is a 1-line primitive change. This blocks acceptance of almost every L5 key that inflicts a negative status.
update0355: Community corroboration (not evidence): in-game tooltips of most negative statuses say there is a cumulative 10% chance to recover each turn, Poison excepted (community.gemsofwar.com/t/poison-the-unnatural-status-effect/68824); a single self-cleanse roll removes all negatives and any newly applied effect resets it (community.gemsofwar.com/t/essence-of-evil-effects-are-lumped-together-resolved/53455). Engine rolls per status and additionally hard-caps at 3 turns. Content was rephrased for compliance with licensing restrictions.

expected: rulings/R006-C3: random steps prefer enemies not yet hit in this cast, repeat only when every living enemy was hit (4 steps on 4 enemies -> 4 distinct).
actual: targeting.ts enemyRandomPrefNotPrev excludes only castTracking.lastTarget (immediately previous step); step 4 can hit the step-2 target while an unhit enemy lives. The same primitive is used by batch-08 (L4b-6841), batch-10 (comment: alternating with 2 enemies), batch-r9/r10/r12/r22 splash chains; damage.ts randomSplashCount / randomDamageWaves already implement the C3 reading (prefer not-yet-hit).
note: Two readings coexist in the engine; changing enemyRandomPrefNotPrev affects other lanes (L4b and others). Needs coordinator confirmation that C3 applies to the targeting mode as well, then a one-line primitive change (exclude all castTracking.allTargets).
